Configure split and findability by name

Two ora.ai fixes for the docs site. Drag the budget to see which generated pages fit; toggle the split to see the fix.

Page token budget

Tokens are estimated at 4 bytes per token, the same rough rule the audit uses. Bytes are the real generated MDX sizes on this branch.
